tonight.headline: Nothing changed overnight — Friday's report is the last check
body: Bad news first: Alvin Kamara is still limited with the back (Saints Wednesday report, Paris) and stays the fourth back; Thursday night's Bears-Patriots game involved nobody on either roster. Rico Dowdle was limited again Thursday with the knee (SteelersNow via Fantasy Footballers) — if he sits on Sunday, that only helps Jaylen Warren.

Love (full Thursday, 'no chance' he misses Detroit) and Jefferson (full Thursday) are the only two starters who were ever in doubt, and Friday's designations land this afternoon, after this run. ESPN has AVIATO 60%, 130.8 to JuiceJam's 112.0. Nothing to do now.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: JuiceJam need Bryce Young (17.8, Coker's own quarterback), Lamb and LaPorta to beat their numbers while Love and Jefferson underperform theirs. Their Josh Jacobs is day-to-day in his first game back from the Exempt List.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Love or Jefferson designated on Friday's report — then Rodgers (free, 19.7) is the only quarterback cover; Stafford is gone, added by Aye-Aye at 07:21Z today.

whatWentWrong.title: Three bye players on the bench left no Sunday fallback — this week practice bailed it out
whatWentWrong.lead: Allen, Tuten and Diggs are on bye; Love and Jefferson were both limited Wednesday with nobody playable behind them.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Tuesday's waiver run brought Diggs (bye) for McLaurin and Metcalf for Allgeier, leaving Kamara and Metcalf — both in the 07:30 Paris game — as the only playable bench. On Wednesday Love (back) and Jefferson (ankle) were both on their teams' reports.

case.label: How it resolved
case.body: Both were upgraded to full on Thursday (Packers.com, Vikings.com 22 Oct) and no new item appeared overnight. And the cover has thinned: Matthew Stafford, this week's insurance quarterback, was added by Aye-Aye at 07:21Z today — Rodgers (19.7) is the only free starter left. The roster did not solve it; the injuries did.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Love or Jefferson is designated on Friday afternoon's report after Thursday's full practice — then the gap matters again and Rodgers is the only quarterback answer.

whatWentWrong.sources: ESPN activity log · Packers.com 22 Oct · Vikings.com 22 Oct

whatWentWrong.title: Week 6 was won with 11.0 left on the bench
whatWentWrong.lead: Kamara's 14.9 sat behind Allgeier's 5.8 and Love's 20.2 behind Allen's 18.3 — both projection calls, neither an override.

case.label: The numbers
case.body: 122.6 to 82.94 over Bok-aneers; best possible lineup 133.6 (week-6 archive, recomputed this run).

case.label: The lesson
case.body: Both were projection calls that lost. The fix is not to override — it is to set the lineup every week, which is done for Week 7: the lineup as set is the projection lineup.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: A Week 7 lineup set by projection leaves more than 15 points on the bench (archive).

waiverAnalysis.summary: Unchanged: the weakest movable receiver is Diggs — on bye and on the screen's exposure list — so the two risers clear a bar that cannot be acted on. Both fill someone else's vacancy. Six weeks of data, still thin.
